description.text: Program Description This program is the primary way of entering MBBS program of Capital Medical University; students will have a chance of learning basic subjects needed for clinical medicine course. Students will have enough time to get settled in China and understand the living and learning environment. Main Courses Medical terminology, biology, chemistry, Chinese language. For some students we might give English classes as well. Fee Structure For the students who join the Pre-Medical Program(Spring) Fee Description Total fee for Pre-med 25000 RMB Course duration: one semester Tuition & Dorm For the students who join in Pre-Medical/Clinical Medicine(Spring/Fall onetime payment) Fee Description Incidentals 18650 RMB Including: Admission fee Text books Registration fee Dorm fee Medical checkup Insurance Resident permit Lab coat Dorm deposit

duration.text: The Pre-Medical chinese Program at Capital Medical University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3472 USD/In total ￥ 25000 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Graduation certificate of high school Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. 18-40 years old, healthy; 2. Willing to obey Chinese laws and regulations and regulations of Capital Medical University; 3. High school graduate.
